description: This is a PHP class definition for EmployeeSalaryService in the OrangeHRM system. It provides a service to access employee salary data via an EmployeeSalaryDao data access object, implementing lazy initialization for the DAO instance.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling employee salary related operations, acting as a mediator between controllers and DAO.

methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao, creating it if not already instantiated.
